jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

Under supervision, perform technical and specialized work of a skilled nature in connection with electrical systems, electronics, and instrument and control systems.

Must be able to read, interpret and work from moderately complex prints and specifications.

Must have a working knowledge of equipment and clearance procedures, and the rules, safety practices and procedures applicable to the work.

Must obtain and maintain all necessary certifications and licenses as required.

Must be available for callout.

Climb ladders & stairs a number of times each day. Use fine dexterity to move switches & controls to precise locations. Detect color on alarms, equipment & other devices Hear announcements on the Plant PA system, and to hear abnormal sounds of plant equipment. Communicate plant information by phone, in person or by radio Work

Nicely Co. is seeking a Automation Test Engineer to strengthen risk-based testing, defect prevention, test design, automation, release confidence, and quality measurement. • Own day-to-day work across risk-based testing, defect prevention, test design, automation, release confidence, and quality measurement.

• Commitment to ethical conduct, confidentiality, security, accessibility, and inclusive collaboration.
Preferred qualifications
• Experience with modern methods and tools used in Quality Assurance.
• Experience in a startup, small business, or other resource-conscious environment.
• Evidence of improving a workflow, standard, product, service, or measurable outcome.

jobs.title: Mechanical Test & Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
McElroy is looking for a Test Engineer with knowledge and experience to develop test plans, procedures, and methods for complex machines. The successful test engineer will be collaborative in work style with the ability to work with a variety of departments. This position creates and executes test procedures to verify that the product’s mechanical, electrical power, hydraulic, and control systems meet specifications while analyzing and presenting test results and data to the design teams to ensure the verification and validation of all product requirements.
Responsibilities

• Evaluate test methods and equipment for the simulation of various mechanical and environmental conditions.
• Generate test plans, procedures, and work instructions from product specifications.
• Execute and conduct environmental and mechanical tests in accordance with test requirements and developed procedures.
• Setup, configure, and operate test setups, fixtures, and instrumentation as required by test plans, test standards, and other instructions.
• Implement and deploy test fixtures, testing apparatus and machines and verify their appropriateness.
• Ensure the accuracy and consistency of data through thorough documentation processes.
• Analyze and present test results and data to the design team and work with the team to resolve issues found during testing.
• Source, obtain quotations, and select required lab supplies and materials to build test fixtures to conduct tests.
• Design and assemble test fixtures per test plan, and applicable test standards.
• Validate test methods.
• Analyze and test new or revised designs to ensure the product is efficient and safe.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Agricultural Engineering required.
• Professional Engineer license preferred.
• 3-5 years of work experience in a related field.
• Knowledge of machines, mechanisms, materials, electrical power, general physics, control systems and hydraulics
• Knowledge of setting up and running data acquisition systems, similar to Labview and Somat/Catman
• Ability to comprehend, interpret, and implement industry standard test methodologies
• Ability to read blueprints, diagrams, drawings, and sketches is essential.
• Intermediate skill level in SolidWorks preferred.
• Collaborating with all stakeholders of a project: from assembly technicians to engineers to purchasing agents.

Must be able to routinely work between office and shop environment. Balance of work day may require bending, squatting, and climbing, while working on large scale products. Some domestic travel required. Mobility required between multi building complex covering several acres.

Jobs which involve one or more tasks or duties that could affect the safety and health of the employee performing the task or others are considered safety-sensitive. This position is safety-sensitive because, in addition to the essential functions, it also involves performing one or more of the following essential tasks or duties:
• The handling, packaging, processing, storage, disposal or transport of hazardous material

jobs.title: Quality Engineer - Aerospace
jobs.description:
The Quality Engineer (QE) plays a critical role in ensuring the quality and

reliability of processing operations within the organization. This QE role is responsible for implementing and maintaining quality assurance processes, conducting audits, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and product quality.

This role is identified as requiring ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) compliance; therefore, qualified candidates must meet the definition of a U.S. Person (per EAR Part 772 and ITAR 120.15):
• An individual who is granted U.S. citizenship, or
• An individual who is granted U.S. permanent residence (i.e., a "Green Card" holder), or
• An individual who is granted status as a "protected person"

Essential Functions

To accomplish this job, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
• Develop and implement quality control procedures and processes for operations to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards; participate in the design and development of new processing methods, equipment, and materials, ensuring alignment with quality requirements and objectives
• Conduct regular audits and inspections of equipment, materials, and procedures to identify potential areas for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate and resolve quality-related issues, including root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions
• Analyze processing and chemical laboratory data and performance metrics to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for process optimization and efficiency improvement
• Provide technical support and guidance to production personnel on quality-related matters, including process troubleshooting and optimization
• Facilitate training sessions and workshops to educate employees on quality assurance principles, procedures, and best practices
• Maintain documentation related to quality control processes, including procedures, work instructions, and records of inspections and audits
• Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to ensure the quality and reliability of incoming materials and components used in processing operations
• Stay updated on industry trends, regulations, and best practices related to processing quality assurance and incorporate relevant knowledge into operations
• Performs other duties as required
• Work is to be performed on-site at the manufacturing facility during a regularly assigned shift

Required Education and Work Experience
• A bachelors degree in engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field is required; a combination of specialized training and relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of degree
• Three (3) years of work experience in quality assurance/quality control for manufacturing is required; experience in a processing environment is preferred
• A comprehensive understanding of quality management systems, regulatory requirements, and industry standards (i.e. ISO 9001, AS9100, NADCAP) is required
• Internal audit and ISO or similar Certification Audit experience is required (AS9100 preferred)
• Proficiency in root cause analysis, statistical analysis, and problem-solving methodologies (i.e. Six Sigma, DMAIC) is required
• Specialized training and experience conducting continuous improvement activities is preferred

Other Required Skills and Abilities
• Ability to accurately read and interpret blueprints, sketches, drawings, and technical specifications is required
• Professional written and verbal communication (English) to convey both technical and non-technical information and instructions is required
• Computer proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) is required; experience administering Share

jobs.title: Scientific Software Developer for MPAS Infrastructure
jobs.description:

Lynker Corporation is seeking a Scientific Software Developer to support MPAS infrastructure and integrate the Model for Prediction Across Scales (MPAS) as a new dynamical core within the UFS Weather Model. The role focuses on coupling infrastructure, component updates, model testing, portability, performance, and continued development of the UFS model. The ideal candidate is local to the DC Metro area and will work a hybrid schedule: two days per week in the College Park, Maryland office and three days per week from home.

The developer will work across scientific software and high-performance computing platforms, supporting build systems, automated testing, CI workflows, and heterogeneous computing capabilities such as GPUs. The role also involves performance profiling, debugging, code documentation, and applying generative AI tools to code and technical documentation development.

The position serves as a technical point of contact for external model components and UFS stakeholders. It includes reviewing and integrating contributions from multiple teams, maintaining external component awareness, and providing technical mentoring. Candidates must be U.S. citizens or Green Card holders and should indicate their status in their cover letter.

Responsibilities
• Develop infrastructure to integrate MPAS as a new dynamical core in the UFS Weather Model, including necessary component updates and integration.
• Develop, expand, and support NUOPC caps, coupling infrastructure, coupled field exchanges, component interactions, and mediator configurations.
• Develop capabilities and modular frameworks for standalone testing of individual components in the coupled model.
• Ensure portability of compiled code, build configurations, and unit and regression testing workflows across scientific HPC platforms, including support for heterogeneous computing such as GPUs.

• Build, maintain, debug, and refactor automated CI workflows and use modern Git-based code management and agile development practices.
• Identify, evaluate, and apply GenAI and LLM tools to improve model development, code generation, and technical documentation.
• Monitor developments in scientific HPC hardware, compilers, and software architectures to help the UFS model adapt to technological changes.
• Serve as subject matter expert and technical point of contact for CICE and CDEPS, tracking external repository developments that affect the UFS Weather Model.
• Manage relationships with UFS Weather Model stakeholders and application teams, act as a point of contact, and review and integrate multi-team contributions.
• Maintain code documentation, troubleshoot build failures and runtime errors, use advanced debugging tools, and provide technical mentoring to colleagues.
• Maintain user-facing developer documentation.

Requirements
• Must be a U.S. citizen or Green Card holder and indicate this in the cover letter.

Capsule is rebuilding the pharmacy experience to be smarter, friendlier, and faster. For over a decade, we have offered free same-day home delivery. Today, we operate nationally and have raised over $500M from premier healthcare and tech investors.

To eliminate prescription friction, our ClearRx product integrates directly with specialty practices' EMR systems. We handle insurance benefit checks, prior authorizations, patient communications, and delivery on their behalf.

AI powers our scale. We build end-to-end AI agents for prescription workflows, backed by human judgment where needed. Our engineers leverage AI coding tools, partner closely with business teams, and directly impact patient and provider care.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will work directly with business stakeholders to understand key Capsule workflows and build AI agents that improve them. You will own projects end to end, from mapping the process to delivering production systems that drive measurable business outcomes, with a "right and fast" approach.

• Partner with business stakeholders to map key workflows end to end and identify opportunities for automation and process improvement

• Design, build and deploy AI agents, along with the APIs, services and workflows that support them, using Python, Kotlin or other programming languages your team uses

• Build evaluations and backtesting to measure agent accuracy before launch, and monitor performance in production

• Define success metrics for each project, track results against them, and iterate until business goals are met

• Write Technical Specs that communicate architectural approaches and present them to internal peers for review and feedback

• Provide mentorship to other engineers through code reviews and architecture reviews

Requirements:

• You have 3 - 5 years of overall software engineering experience

• You are an expert in one or more mainstream programming languages such as Python or Kotlin

• You have experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or AI agents in production

• You have experience designing evaluations and monitoring for AI systems

• You use AI coding tools as a regular part of your development workflow

• You have experience developing and maintaining full-stack applications, including both frontend and backend services

• You are comfortable working directly with business stakeholders and translating their needs into technical solutions

• You have been part of a team that owned software components critical to driving business outcomes

What We Offer

• The starting anticipated earnings for this position is between $150,000 and $200,000 base salary contingent on performance and leveling.

• Compensation packages include base pay and benefits

• Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage

• The opportunity to work alongside some of the brightest minds in healthcare and technology

• The opportunity to execute on a high-impact mission, to build a pharmacy that works for everyone, within a $425 billion pharmacy industry touching 70% of Americans once a month

Capsule is committed to hiring the best team possible to build a pharmacy that works for everyone. We have a diverse set of problems to solve, and believe that we need a diverse set of perspectives to deliver the best possible solutions to those problems. We look for talent from a wide range of backgrounds - including but not limited to - race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.
